notes.title: 【上一个版本的追加补丁】1.43
notes.notes:
1.42更新引擎后，新玩家会在解锁线索(等改变游戏进度)的时候报错，现已修复。
原因：新版本引擎中，持久化数据的初始化规则与旧版发生了改变。
范围：1.42版本更新后首次运行游戏的玩家。
感谢热心玩家的及时反馈！

notes.title: 【有风险的稳定性更新】1.42 引擎更新提升兼容性
notes.notes:
将Ren'Py更新至8.2.0，优化游戏对部分显卡兼容性差导致卡顿闪退的问题。
该版本可能的负面影响：
1.由于新版本代码有删改，可能导致旧存档无法读取，对引起的不便深表歉意。请读取更早的存档并使用快进功能进行跳过。
2.结尾小游戏中需要输入的时候，从输入框改为了虚拟键盘，请将答案以拼音形式输入。
3.存在其他可能造成的未知影响，请向官方账号或在官方群中反馈，会及时更新修复。

notes.title: v1.30 Describe
notes.notes:
1. Little green has learned two cool jokes

2. Optimize achievement acquisition and reduce failure probability

3. Other small bugs such as typos

notes.title: v1.22 Describe
notes.notes:
When selecting evidence, it may not be possible to close the selection evidence menu. For this problem, 1.22 has been fixed.

Reading the previous archive of the card off position can be solved.

notes.title: v1.20 Describe
notes.notes:
1. Increase the number of archives to 16 pages

2. It is allowed to exit directly in a small game without waiting for the countdown to end

3. During the game, you can retrieve the evidence list at any time, and click "evidence" in the menu (the same level menu as history and archive page). Note: the evidence list needs to get the process of the game, so you can't view the evidence by opening it in "chapter".

4. Fix known text and description errors

notes.title: v1.1.7 Describe
notes.notes:
Add the OpenGL switch function in the setting interface. Only players with problems are recommended to choose to turn off.
Turning off OpenGL will affect some display effects, such as failure to display archive thumbnails and screenshots normally.
The window cannot be zoomed. If a full screen game is needed, it is recommended to set it to full screen mode before closing OpenGL. The next run will start in full screen mode.
This patch is only a temporary fix. If a better solution is found, it will be improved later.
